types.name: AttributeData
marshal:
switch x.Type {
case AttributeDataTypeBool:
	r.Bool(&x.BoolValue)
	OptionalFunc(r, &x.BoolOperation, r.Int32)
case AttributeDataTypeFloat:
	r.Float32(&x.FloatValue)
	OptionalFunc(r, &x.FloatOperation, r.Int32)
	OptionalFunc(r, &x.FloatConstraintMin, r.Float32)
	OptionalFunc(r, &x.FloatConstraintMax, r.Float32)
case AttributeDataTypeColour:
	r.Int32(&x.ColourValue)
	OptionalFunc(r, &x.ColourOperation, r.Int32)
default:
	r.UnknownEnumOption(x.Type, "attribute data type")
}

types.name: DataStoreChangeEntry
marshal:
switch x.ChangeType {
case DataStoreChangeTypeUpdate:
	Single(r, &x.Update)
case DataStoreChangeTypeChange:
	r.String(&x.Change.DataStoreName)
	r.String(&x.Change.Property)
	r.Uint32(&x.Change.UpdateCount)
	MarshalDataStorePropertyValue(r, &x.Change.NewValue)
case DataStoreChangeTypeRemoval:
	r.String(&x.Removal.DataStoreName)
default:
	r.UnknownEnumOption(x.ChangeType, "data store change type")
}

types.name: DataStoreUpdate
marshal:
switch x.ControlType {
case DataStoreControlDouble:
	r.Float64(&x.DoubleValue)
case DataStoreControlBoolean:
	r.Bool(&x.BoolValue)
case DataStoreControlString:
	r.String(&x.StringValue)
default:
	r.UnknownEnumOption(x.ControlType, "data store control type")
}

types.name: ItemStackResponse
MapTrackedObject
ScoreboardEntry
marshal:
switch x.IdentityType {
case ScoreboardIdentityRemove:
	objective := Optional[string]{}
	if x.ObjectiveName != "" {
		objective = Option(x.ObjectiveName)
	}
	OptionalFunc(r, &objective, r.String)
	x.ObjectiveName, _ = objective.Value()
case ScoreboardIdentityEntity, ScoreboardIdentityPlayer:
	r.String(&x.ObjectiveName)
	r.Int32(&x.Score)
	r.ActorUniqueID(&x.EntityUniqueID)
case ScoreboardIdentityFakePlayer:
	r.String(&x.ObjectiveName)
	r.Int32(&x.Score)
	r.String(&x.DisplayName)
}

types.name: Skin
SoundDataUpdate
marshal:
switch x.Type {
case SoundDataUpdateStop, SoundDataUpdatePause, SoundDataUpdateResume:
case SoundDataUpdateSetVolume:
	io.Float32(&x.Volume)
case SoundDataUpdateSetPitch:
	io.Float32(&x.Pitch)
case SoundDataUpdateFade:
	io.Float32(&x.Duration)
	io.Float32(&x.TargetVolume)
case SoundDataUpdateSeekTo:
	io.Float32(&x.Seconds)
default:
	io.UnknownEnumOption(x.Type, "sound data update type")
}
